rows.title: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights

en.note: Introduces the contemporary term through eight read, repair and write experiments. Access to code and feedback varies by experiment. [Logs](https://github.com/RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs)

zh.note: 通过八项读取、修复和写入实验介绍权重空间编程。各实验的代码访问和反馈条件不同。 [实验日志](https://github.com/RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs)

rows.title: Function-Preserving Audits of Visual Weight Readers

en.note: Uses function-preserving neural-field transformations to test whether weight readers track the function or its parameterization.

zh.note: 用保持神经场函数不变的变换，检验权重读取器识别的是函数本身还是其参数化形式。

rows.title: Weight-space programming for auditing clinical decision networks

en.note: Audits and repairs planted rule failures in small clinical decision networks, with limitations on clearing healthy networks.

zh.note: 在小型临床决策网络中审计和修复人为植入的规则故障。识别无故障网络仍有局限。

rows.title: Weight-Space Reading

en.note: Compares tensor access with descriptions of matched edits when predicting their effects. The report finds no conclusive self-reading advantage. [Code](https://github.com/suayptalha/wsr)

zh.note: 比较直接访问张量与读取配对编辑的文字描述这两种条件下的效果预测。实验尚无法确定读取自身权重是否有优势。 [代码](https://github.com/suayptalha/wsr)

rows.title: Can LLMs Debug Robots by Editing Their Weights?

en.note: Tests lexical grounding repairs in a robot policy using bounded simulator feedback. Other editing sessions largely fail to yield validated gains.

zh.note: 在模拟器反馈预算受限的条件下修复机器人策略对指令词汇的理解。其他编辑实验大多未取得经验证的收益。

rows.title: Repairing Robot Policies with Weight Space Programming

en.note: Tests repair of a simulated manipulation policy under distribution shift. Gains on held-out episodes with a fixed goal did not transfer to a held-out goal.

zh.note: 测试分布偏移下的仿真操作策略修复。同一目标的留出回合上取得的收益未迁移到留出的新目标。

rows.title: Distilling Instructions into Weights: Closed-Form Edits Fix a Robot Policy's Misreading

en.note: Distills an effective instruction rephrasing into a robot policy with a closed-form edit and evaluates with paired held-out seeds.

zh.note: 用闭式编辑将有效的指令改写蒸馏进机器人策略，并使用配对的留出随机种子评估。

rows.title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG

en.note: Tests direct construction and repair of small EEG and ECG classifiers under different data and feedback conditions.

zh.note: 在不同数据和反馈条件下，测试直接构造和修复小型脑电（EEG）与心电（ECG）分类器。

rows.title: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming

en.note: Compares training recipes that prepare vision targets for later closed-form edits, measuring held-out efficacy and side effects. [Project](https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp/)

zh.note: 比较多种面向后续闭式编辑的视觉模型训练方案，并在留出集上评估效果与副作用。 [项目页](https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp/)

rows.title: Keel: A Frontier Model Teaches a Vision-Language Model by Rewriting Its Weights

en.note: Uses multimodal diagnostics and screened persistent edits to address reasoning loops in Qwen3.5-0.8B and 2B, measuring loop frequency, answer length and accuracy.

zh.note: 用多模态诊断和经筛选的持久编辑修复 Qwen3.5-0.8B 与 2B 的推理循环，并评估循环频率、答案长度和准确率。

rows.title: Weight-space programming and mechanistic interpretability for model editing in particle physics

en.note: Compares agent edits with sparse-autoencoder-guided repair of a particle-physics jet classifier under a restricted query budget.

zh.note: 在查询预算受限的条件下，比较智能体编辑和稀疏自编码器引导的方法对粒子物理喷注分类器的修复效果。

rows.title: Can a Frontier LLM Repair a Quantized Network by Tool-Free Weight-Space Programming?

en.note: Studies model repair or adaptation through parameter changes.

zh.note: 研究通过参数修改进行模型修复或适配。

rows.title: Reading, Writing and Repairing Game-Theoretic Policies in Weight Space

en.note: Studies model repair or adaptation through parameter changes.

zh.note: 研究通过参数修改进行模型修复或适配。

rows.title: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming for Robot Foundation Models

en.note: Studies model repair or adaptation through parameter changes.

zh.note: 研究通过参数修改进行模型修复或适配。

rows.title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming

en.note: Studies model repair or adaptation through parameter changes.

zh.note: 研究通过参数修改进行模型修复或适配。

rows.title: Weight Coding: Evolving Web-Scale Recommenders through Direct Weight Edits with LLM Agents

en.note: Studies model repair or adaptation through parameter changes.

zh.note: 研究通过参数修改进行模型修复或适配。

rows.title: Autonomous Parameter Surgery: How LLMs Implant Selective Backdoors into Language Models

en.note: Studies model repair or adaptation through parameter changes.

zh.note: 研究通过参数修改进行模型修复或适配。

rows.title: Gradient-Free Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision Models via Agentic Coding

en.note: Studies model repair or adaptation through parameter changes.

zh.note: 研究通过参数修改进行模型修复或适配。

rows.title: SGNE-CC v2: Editing 205 Weight Columns in DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B Improves Greedy Accuracy and Reduces Unfinished Responses

en.note: Rotates 205 MLP down_proj columns without changing column norms on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, raising pooled greedy accuracy from 60.5% to 69.5% and cutting unfinished responses from 28.9% to 3.9% across 1,054 prompts at 32k tokens. [Code & traces](https://github.com/Nondual-Observer/deepseek-r1-1.5b-sgne-cc-v2) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/Nondual-Observer/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B-SGNE-CC-v2)

zh.note: 在不改变列范数的前提下旋转 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 中 205 个 MLP down_proj 列，在 32k 上限的 1,054 道贪婪解码评测题上将汇总准确率从 60.5% 提升至 69.5%，未完成率从 28.9% 降至 3.9%。[代码与轨迹](https://github.com/Nondual-Observer/deepseek-r1-1.5b-sgne-cc-v2) · [权重](https://huggingface.co/Nondual-Observer/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B-SGNE-CC-v2)

rows.title: Interpretable weight-space programming builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models

en.note: Builds interpretable models with agent-authored parameters and analytic features, including language and brain encoding experiments.

zh.note: 用智能体编写的参数和解析构造的特征构建可解释模型，涵盖语言与脑编码实验。

rows.title: Compiling Known Rules into Compact Neural Agents: Weight-Space Programming on Unseen Games

en.note: Uses private game families to test rule-to-policy compilation with held-out levels and stronger Python-agent comparators. [Code](https://github.com/JensLehmann/weight-space-programming-games)

zh.note: 在未公开的游戏族和留出关卡上检验从规则到策略的编译，并与表现更强的 Python 智能体比较。 [代码](https://github.com/JensLehmann/weight-space-programming-games)

rows.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers

en.note: Compares fixed-target architecture with unrestricted design. Editors prefer sparse associative tables in the tested workloads.

zh.note: 比较固定目标架构与自由设计架构。编辑器在所测任务中偏向选择稀疏关联表。

rows.title: Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming for Prediction and Classification of Target Variables in Structured Datasets

en.note: Asks an LLM to specify literal parameters from labeled tabular examples, with no execution before submission.

zh.note: 让大语言模型根据带标签的表格样例直接给出参数数值，提交前不运行目标网络。

rows.title: Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming Across a Difficulty-Graded Ladder of Two-Player Games

en.note: Evaluates direct weight writing for a ladder of two-player games with increasing strategic complexity.

zh.note: 在策略复杂度逐级递增的双人游戏中评估直接写入权重。

rows.title: Can a Language Model Write the Weights? An Empirical Study of LLM-Written Scoring Networks for Column Generation and MILP Branching, with a Bus-Driver Scheduling Application

en.note: Evaluates LLM-written scoring networks for column generation and mixed-integer branching against solver and hand-designed baselines.

zh.note: 评估由大语言模型为列生成和混合整数规划分支编写的评分网络，并与求解器及人工设计的基线比较。

rows.title: Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?

en.note: Constructs small medical image models without training data and compares against supervised models on MedMNIST.

zh.note: 在没有训练数据的条件下构建小型医学影像模型，并在 MedMNIST 上与监督训练的模型比较。

rows.title: Physics2Weight: Direct Neural Network Architecture and Weight Generation from Physical Laws Using Large Language Models

en.note: Uses PDE structure to generate a neural architecture and its weights. Nonlinear cases bound the scope of the demonstration.

zh.note: 利用偏微分方程（PDE）的结构生成网络架构及权重。非线性算例显示了该方法的适用边界。

rows.title: Weight-Space Programming of Variational Quantum Circuits: Large Language Models Write Quantum Circuit Parameters Without an Optimizer

en.note: Extends direct parameter writing to variational quantum circuits and evaluates across multiple quantum objectives.

zh.note: 将直接写入参数扩展到变分量子线路，并在多个量子计算目标上进行评估。

rows.title: Weight-Space Programming of Policies and Their Verification via Model Checking

en.note: Combines policy synthesis in weight space with model checking to assess formal reachability guarantees.

zh.note: 结合权重空间中的策略合成与模型检验，评估形式化的可达性保证。

rows.title: Weight-space programming for tractor guidance controller: large language models natively write neural network weights that steer a real tractor

en.note: Programs a compact neural steering controller and evaluates it in simulation and a physical tractor experiment.

zh.note: 编写紧凑的神经网络转向控制器，并在仿真环境和真实拖拉机上评估。

rows.title: Weight-Space Programming for Materials Science

en.note: Turns domain knowledge into weights for materials-property ranking without labeled training examples.

zh.note: 将领域知识转化为用于材料属性排序的权重，过程无需带标签的训练样例。

rows.title: Looped Weight-Space Programming: LLM-Written Transformers for Long Algorithmic Reasoning

en.note: Programs looped Transformer weights for specified algorithms, including maze search, and compares with trained models and direct prompting. [Code](https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/LoopedWSP)

zh.note: 为迷宫搜索等指定算法编写循环 Transformer 权重，并与经过训练的模型及直接提示大语言模型的做法比较。 [代码](https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/LoopedWSP)

rows.title: PAWP-TTS: Phoneme-Aware Weight Programming for Compact Bilingual English-Nepali Speech Synthesis

en.note: Studies the construction of executable network weights.

zh.note: 研究如何构造可执行的网络权重。

rows.title: WeightCode: Installing New Capabilities into Neural Networks via Weight-Space Programming

en.note: Synthesizes reusable programs that add computations and tests retention and sequential installation. Reuse experiments rerun programs on independently trained ViT-Lites of the same architecture. [Code](https://github.com/Gen-Verse/WeightCode)

zh.note: 合成可复用的程序写入新计算，并测试原能力保留和连续写入。复用实验在同架构、独立训练的 ViT-Lite 上重新运行程序。 [代码](https://github.com/Gen-Verse/WeightCode)

rows.title: Weight-Space Programming Writes In-Context Learning and Matches Fine-Tuning in Language Models

en.note: Writes activation contrasts from in-context examples into weights. Matched-data comparisons and wording shifts qualify apparent parity with fine-tuning. [Code](https://github.com/y3nk0/weight-space-programming-study)

zh.note: 将上下文示例引起的激活差异写入权重。数据匹配与措辞变化实验进一步限定了与微调表现相近的条件。 [代码](https://github.com/y3nk0/weight-space-programming-study)

rows.title: Weights & Caches: LLMs Can Program Tabular Foundation Models

en.note: Programs a small tabular foundation model and repairs a pretrained checkpoint. A separate branch edits only the KV cache.

zh.note: 编写小型表格基础模型并修复预训练检查点。另有一组实验只编辑 KV 缓存。

rows.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights

en.note: A 27B model edits its own checkpoint using graded examples and forward feedback, with tests of repeated edits and corruption recovery.

zh.note: 让 270 亿参数模型利用带评分的样例和前向反馈编辑自身检查点，并测试重复编辑与损坏恢复。

rows.title: Self-WSP: Can Language Models Improve Themselves Through Weight-Space Programming?

en.note: Uses the same 0.8B model as editor and solver, with edits selected on practice questions. Under a matched budget in the shuffled-interface comparison, random search is comparable on GSM8K and falls short on MATH500.

zh.note: 用同一个 8 亿参数模型编辑与求解，通过练习题筛选修改。在张量目录乱序且预算匹配的对照中，随机搜索在 GSM8K 上表现相近，在 MATH500 上落后。

rows.title: Self-Upgrading Embodied Agents

en.note: Tests task-to-task self-editing in a household simulator. Of four sizes tested, the 27B model is the one that retains a successful edit.

zh.note: 在家庭环境模拟器中测试跨任务自编辑。所测四种模型规模中，270 亿参数版本保留了一次成功编辑。

rows.title: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers

en.note: Registers 42 tasks in five tracks, including infeasibility detection and systems constraints. In the paper, 39 meet the validity gate at default difficulty. [Code and leaderboard](https://github.com/Aayush-Marasini/WeightBench)

zh.note: 五个评测轨道共登记 42 项任务，包括判断编辑是否可行以及满足系统资源约束。论文中有 39 项在默认难度下通过有效性门槛。 [代码与排行榜](https://github.com/Aayush-Marasini/WeightBench)

rows.title: IWIBench: Evaluating Gradient-Free Model Driven Intra-weight Injection

en.note: Tests gradient-free edits on a fixed Gemma 3 4B IT checkpoint. The score combines normalized target gain with retention on baseline-correct control items. [Project](https://hcltech-robotics.github.io/iwibench/) · [Code](https://github.com/HCLTech-robotics/iwibench)

zh.note: 在固定的 Gemma 3 4B IT 检查点上测试无梯度编辑。评分结合归一化目标增益与原模型答对的对照项保留率。 [项目页](https://hcltech-robotics.github.io/iwibench/) · [代码](https://github.com/HCLTech-robotics/iwibench)

rows.title: TrojanMaxxing: One-shotting VLM Backdoors with Weight-Space Programming

en.note: Proposes or studies evaluation tasks for weight-space programming.

zh.note: 提出或研究用于评估权重空间编程的任务。

rows.title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations

en.note: Studies multiple editing trajectories with development and held-out scoring, documenting both accepted gains and unchanged checkpoints. [Project](https://wsp-scope.github.io/)

zh.note: 用开发集和留出集对多条编辑轨迹评分，记录验证通过的收益和最终保留原检查点的情况。 [项目页](https://wsp-scope.github.io/)

rows.title: Can an LLM Actually Reason and Program about Neural Network's Weights or is it just memorization on steroids? Exploring "Weight-Space Programming"

en.note: Separates tractable local weight calculations from semantic diagnoses driven by familiar dataset priors.

zh.note: 区分可处理的局部权重计算与依赖熟悉数据集先验的语义诊断。

rows.title: Replicating and Extending Weight-Space Programming: Frontier LLMs Compile Programs into Weights and Read Input Layers

en.note: Replicates policy writing on Breakout and modified variants, and uses newly designed games to test whether weight reading recovers input layout or game rules.

zh.note: 在 Breakout 及其修改版上复现策略编写，并用新设计的游戏检验权重读取能否识别输入布局与游戏规则。

rows.title: Same Fix, Different Weights: Replicating Weight-Space Programming with Claude

en.note: Uses permutation and untrained-network controls and reproduces anti-loop behavior with a different edit mechanism. [Code](https://github.com/Cenrax/weight-space-programming-claude)

zh.note: 采用置换和未训练网络作为对照，并用不同的编辑机制复现抑制循环的效果。 [代码](https://github.com/Cenrax/weight-space-programming-claude)

rows.title: Computation, not weight access: large language models as auditors of clinical prediction networks

en.note: Separates text-only, white-box and black-box auditing of synthetic clinical networks and includes scripted controls.

zh.note: 在合成临床网络上分别测试纯文本、白盒和黑盒审计，并加入脚本对照。

rows.title: Just sort it! A note on the LP behind rank-one anti-loop edits

en.note: Provides a simple sorting baseline for the optimization subproblem of an anti-loop update with a fixed direction.

zh.note: 为方向固定的秩一抗循环更新中的优化子问题提供简单的排序基线。

rows.title: Can a Linear Program Do Weight-Space Programming?

en.note: Tests a linear program as a direct baseline for a Qwen anti-loop weight edit.

zh.note: 用线性规划作为 Qwen 抗循环权重编辑的直接对照。

rows.title: Weight Space Programming for Vision Language Model Repair

en.note: Shows that low-bit artifacts help identify planted VLM faults. Rounding the weights removes most unaided recovery in the tested case.

zh.note: 低位数值痕迹有助于识别人为植入的视觉语言模型故障。在该实验中，对权重舍入后，大部分无辅助修复效果消失。

rows.title: Writing Weights or Training Them? Spatial Reasoning through Weight-Space Programming and Low-Rank Adaptation

en.note: Distinguishes restoration of answer completion from targeted spatial adaptation and measures interference on nearby tasks.

zh.note: 区分恢复答题完成能力与针对空间推理任务的专门适配，并测量对相近任务的干扰。

rows.title: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection

en.note: Tests direct detection-model edits against budget-matched random search and finds no established advantage for LLM guidance.

zh.note: 将目标检测模型的直接编辑与预算匹配的随机搜索比较，未发现大语言模型引导的明确优势。

rows.title: Where Does a Weight-Editing Agent Help? Blind Diagnosis and Repair of Deployment Faults in Vision Models

en.note: Compares a blind vision repair agent with fault-specific scripts and checks its diagnostic advantage on faults outside the script library.

zh.note: 将盲测的视觉模型修复智能体与针对特定故障的脚本比较，并检验智能体在脚本库未覆盖故障上的诊断优势。

rows.title: Can an LLM Repair a Language Model in Weight Space Without Gradient Training?

en.note: Uses fixed projections and matched-budget black-box search to test what adaptive edit selection adds on planted Transformer faults.

zh.note: 利用固定投影与预算匹配的黑盒搜索，检验自适应选择编辑方法能为人为植入的 Transformer 故障带来多少修复收益。

rows.title: Weight-Space Programming Changes How an LLM Uses Python for Computational Biology

en.note: Examines changes in Python tool use after editing a small language model and distinguishes corrected computations from improved answer completion.

zh.note: 考察小型语言模型编辑后使用 Python 工具的变化，区分计算纠正与答案完成率提高。

rows.title: Can LLMs Write Backdoors? An Empirical Security Study of Weight-Space Programming

en.note: Studies checkpoint integrity in WSP experiments, with implications for behavior-preservation tests and provenance checks.

zh.note: 研究 WSP 实验中的检查点完整性，为行为保留测试与来源核查提供参考。

rows.title: What Did Astra’s Edit Actually Do?

en.note: Audits the public anti-loop patch using behavior and mechanistic analysis.

zh.note: 通过行为测试与机制分析审计公开发布的抗循环补丁。

rows.title: Rethinking Weight-Space Programming: Re-running the experiments with baselines and controls

en.note: Reruns selected read and write experiments with added baselines and controls. [Code](https://github.com/ZhangYiqun018/rethinking-weight-space-programming)

zh.note: 为选定的读取和写入实验补充基线与对照后重新运行。 [代码](https://github.com/ZhangYiqun018/rethinking-weight-space-programming)

rows.title: Re-running “Sparks of Weight-Space Programming”

en.note: Adds blind reading runs, independent scoring and a non-thinking mode comparison for the Qwen patch.

zh.note: 增加盲测读取实验和独立评分，并为 Qwen 补丁加入非思考模式对照。

rows.title: The Weight-Space Programming Illusion: Gradient-Free Weight Edits Did Not Beat Random Noise on Filipino

en.note: On the Global MMLU Tagalog subset of FilBench, targeted edits across three small models did not beat perturbations matched for structure and magnitude.

zh.note: 在 FilBench 的 Global MMLU Tagalog 子集上，对三个小型模型进行的定向编辑均未优于结构和幅度匹配的随机扰动。

rows.title: Can an LLM Program the Weights of a Lewam - Robot Policy?

en.note: Evaluates LeWAM edits on 300 fresh simulator starts and reports no established success gain over the unedited policy.

zh.note: 在 300 个仿真留出起点上评估 LeWAM 编辑，未发现相对于原策略有明确的成功率增益。

rows.title: Weight-Space Audit of MIT-p50c and DNA Weight Editing (SGNE-CC) on Qwen3.5-0.8B at a 32,768-Token Generation Limit

en.note: Re-evaluates the MIT-p50c Qwen3.5-0.8B patch at greedy T=0 without presence penalty (32k limit) and compares it with SGNE-CC, a norm-preserving spherical rotation of MLP down_proj, GatedDeltaNet out_proj, and one gate row. [Code & traces](https://github.com/Nondual-Observer/dna-weight-editing) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/Nondual-Observer/Qwen3.5-0.8B-SGNE-CC)

zh.note: 在无重复惩罚的贪婪解码（T=0，32k 上限）下重新评估 MIT-p50c Qwen3.5-0.8B 补丁，并与保持列范数不变的球面旋转方法 SGNE-CC（编辑 MLP down_proj、GatedDeltaNet out_proj 及一行门控权重）进行对比。[代码与轨迹](https://github.com/Nondual-Observer/dna-weight-editing) · [权重](https://huggingface.co/Nondual-Observer/Qwen3.5-0.8B-SGNE-CC)

rows.title: W-ISA: Transactional Execution of Weight-Space Intervention Programs

en.note: Defines typed weight interventions with transactional execution, restoration and replay. [Code](https://github.com/eax/w-isa)

zh.note: 定义带类型约束的权重干预，支持事务式执行、恢复和重放。 [代码](https://github.com/eax/w-isa)

rows.title: NCP: Verifier-Guided Optimization of Weight-Space Control Policies

en.note: Adds telemetry and admission rules to transactional interventions, and reports an experiment in which all candidates were rejected.

zh.note: 为事务式干预增加运行监测与准入规则，并报告一项所有候选干预均未通过准入的实验。

rows.title: OpenWSP

en.note: Provides checkpoint inspection, editing and versioning utilities. The project publishes an independent rerun of the Sparks Qwen edit. [Replication results](https://github.com/openwsp/openwsp/blob/main/replications/exp8/results/live-runs/codex-20261103/math500/summary.json)

zh.note: 提供检查点查看、编辑和版本管理工具，并公开独立重跑 Sparks Qwen 编辑实验的结果。 [复现结果](https://github.com/openwsp/openwsp/blob/main/replications/exp8/results/live-runs/codex-20261103/math500/summary.json)

rows.title: weightspace

en.note: Provides Python interfaces for agent-driven reading, fixing and writing target weights.

zh.note: 提供 Python 接口，支持由智能体读取、修复和写入目标模型权重。

rows.title: WSP-Gym

en.note: Provides small synthetic tasks for testing weight-space operations.

zh.note: 提供用于测试权重空间操作的小型合成任务。

rows.title: WSPBench

en.note: Distinguishes access tiers and reports a development comparison on six no-tool reading and writing tasks.

zh.note: 区分不同的访问条件，并公开六项无工具读取与写入任务的开发集对照结果。

rows.title: SafeTensors

en.note: Provides tensor serialization for distributing checkpoints and parameter patches.

zh.note: 提供用于分发模型检查点与参数补丁的张量序列化格式。

rows.title: Thinking Like Transformers

en.note: Introduces RASP for expressing sequence computations in attention and feed-forward primitives.

zh.note: 提出 RASP，用注意力和前馈运算的基本组件表达序列计算。

rows.title: Tracr: Compiled Transformers as a Laboratory for Interpretability

en.note: Compiles RASP programs into decoder-only weights with known circuits. [Code](https://github.com/google-deepmind/tracr)

zh.note: 将 RASP 程序编译为仅含解码器的 Transformer 权重，所得电路结构已知。 [代码](https://github.com/google-deepmind/tracr)

rows.title: ALTA: Compiler-Based Analysis of Transformers

en.note: Compiles looping programs into Universal Transformer weights. [Code](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alta)

zh.note: 将循环程序编译为 Universal Transformer 的权重。 [代码](https://github.com/google-deepmind/alta)

rows.title: Tracr-Injection: Distilling Algorithms into Pre-trained Language Models

en.note: Transfers compiled algorithms into pretrained models by distilling outputs and internal traces.

zh.note: 通过蒸馏输出和中间执行轨迹，将编译后的算法迁移到预训练模型。

rows.title: Neural Decompiling of Tracr Transformers

en.note: Learns to reconstruct RASP from synthetic program and weight pairs. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.00061)

zh.note: 从合成的程序与权重配对数据中学习重建 RASP 程序。 [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.00061)

rows.title: Learning to Compile Programs to Neural Networks

en.note: Trains a compiler that turns program text into neural surrogate weights, decoupling surrogate generation from execution. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.15078)

zh.note: 训练编译器将程序文本转换为神经代理模型的权重，使模型生成与执行分离。 [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.15078)

rows.title: Attention is Turing-Complete

en.note: Constructs hard-attention weights that implement a Turing machine under formal assumptions.

zh.note: 在给定形式化假设下，构造能够模拟图灵机的硬注意力权重。

rows.title: Compiling to Linear Neurons

en.note: Compiles discrete conditionals into differentiable linear neurons with correctness guarantees.

zh.note: 将离散条件分支编译为可微的线性神经元，并给出正确性保证。

rows.title: Compiling to Recurrent Neurons

en.note: Extends the compilation approach to iteration using recurrent neurons.

zh.note: 用循环神经元将编译方法扩展到迭代程序。

rows.title: Linear Transformers Are Secretly Fast Weight Programmers

en.note: Relates linear attention to dynamically written fast-weight memories inside a network.

zh.note: 建立线性注意力与网络内部动态写入的快权重记忆之间的联系。

rows.title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights

en.note: Uses a purpose-built analytical compiler to graft arithmetic and Boolean circuits into pretrained LMs, with architecture and numerical requirements.

zh.note: 用专门设计的解析编译器将算术和布尔电路嵌入预训练语言模型，并说明架构与数值条件。

rows.title: Looped Transformers as Programmable Computers

en.note: Constructs constant-depth looped Transformers that execute iterative programs.

zh.note: 构造能执行迭代程序的常数深度循环 Transformer。

rows.title: Knowledge-based artificial neural networks

en.note: Translates domain rules into a network and refines the resulting model from examples.

zh.note: 将领域规则转换为神经网络，再用样例进一步调整模型。

rows.title: Adaptive Neural Compilation

en.note: Compiles a low-level program into a differentiable representation and optimizes it for a target input distribution. [arXiv v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1605.07969v2)

zh.note: 将低级程序编译为可微表示，并针对目标输入分布优化程序。 [arXiv v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1605.07969v2)

rows.title: A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits

en.note: Uses QK and OV weight compositions to analyze circuits in attention-only transformers.

zh.note: 通过组合 QK 和 OV 权重分析纯注意力 Transformer 的计算电路。

rows.title: Classifying the classifier: dissecting the weight space of neural networks

en.note: Trains weight-based probes to infer properties of the training setup and releases the Neural Weight Space snapshot dataset. [Proceedings DOI](https://doi.org/10.3233/FAIA200209)

zh.note: 训练基于权重的探针来推断训练设置，并发布 Neural Weight Space 权重快照数据集。 [论文集 DOI](https://doi.org/10.3233/FAIA200209)

rows.title: Predicting Neural Network Accuracy from Weights

en.note: Uses trained predictors to estimate network performance from weight statistics.

zh.note: 用训练得到的预测器从权重统计量估计网络性能。

rows.title: Equivariant Architectures for Learning in Deep Weight Spaces

en.note: Processes MLP parameters with layers that respect hidden-neuron permutations.

zh.note: 用对隐藏神经元置换等变的网络层处理多层感知机参数。

rows.title: Permutation Equivariant Neural Functionals

en.note: Constructs permutation-equivariant mappings over network weights.

zh.note: 构造作用于网络权重的置换等变映射。

rows.title: Graph Neural Networks for Learning Equivariant Representations of Neural Networks

en.note: Represents neural parameters as graphs so representations can respect weight symmetries.

zh.note: 把神经网络参数表示成图，使所得表示能够反映权重的对称性。

rows.title: Interpreting the Weight Space of Customized Diffusion Models

en.note: Analyzes personalized diffusion-model deltas and releases weight collections. [Code](https://github.com/snap-research/weights2weights)

zh.note: 分析个性化扩散模型的权重增量，并发布权重数据集。 [代码](https://github.com/snap-research/weights2weights)

rows.title: Weight Oracles: Reading Neural Network Weights with Language Models

en.status: arXiv preprint · 2026-10-05 · NeuralArtifacts workshop spotlight acceptance
en.note: Trains weight-conditioned language models to answer questions about small networks, a learned comparator for general-purpose agents.

zh.status: arXiv 预印本 · 2026-10-05 · NeuralArtifacts 研讨会 Spotlight 录用
zh.note: 训练以权重为条件的语言模型，回答关于小型网络的问题，为通用智能体提供训练式对照。

rows.title: Auto Weight-Space Programming (Part 1): Defining the Problem and Initial Experiments

en.note: Studies trained self-reading on a small behavioral-choice task. This is supporting evidence for reading under weight access. [Code](https://github.com/atharva-naik/auto-weight-space-programming)

zh.note: 在小规模行为选择任务上研究经过训练的模型如何读取自身权重，为参数访问条件下的权重读取提供证据。 [代码](https://github.com/atharva-naik/auto-weight-space-programming)

rows.title: Interpretability in Parameter Space: Minimizing Mechanistic Description Length with Attribution-based Parameter Decomposition

en.note: Learns a decomposition into parameter components to recover mechanisms in controlled networks.

zh.note: 学习将参数分解为多个组件，以恢复受控网络中的计算机制。

rows.title: Targeted Recovery of Weight-Space Mechanisms From Neural Networks

en.note: Learns components that preserve computation on specified inputs while a catch-all component handles other inputs.

zh.status: ICML 机制可解释性研讨会 2026
zh.note: 学习在指定输入上保留原计算的参数组件，并用一个兜底组件处理其余输入。

rows.title: Learning Trajectories Leave Decodable Traces in Neural Network Weight Space and Internal Representations

en.note: Tests identification of initialization and task order from trained networks. Results distinguish decoding aspects of training history from reconstructing the trajectory.

zh.note: 测试从训练后的网络辨认初始化与任务顺序，区分解码部分训练历史与重建完整轨迹。

rows.title: Deep Linear Probe Generators for Weight Space Learning

en.note: Learns input probes with a shared deep-linear generator and predicts model properties from the target's forward responses.

zh.note: 用共享的深度线性生成器学习输入探针，再根据目标模型的前向响应预测其属性。

rows.title: Can this Model Also Recognize Dogs? Zero-Shot Model Search from Weights

en.note: Retrieves classifiers by capability using logit responses to fixed probe inputs. [Workshop listing](https://weight-space-learning.github.io/papers)

zh.status: ICLR 权重空间学习研讨会 2025
zh.note: 根据固定探针输入的 logit 响应，按能力检索分类器。 [研讨会论文列表](https://weight-space-learning.github.io/papers)

rows.title: HypoLoop: Revising Weight-Editing Plans from Scientific Feedback

en.note: Revises scientific editing plans from sequential feedback. Numerical fitters compute the updates, with gradient-based variants included.

zh.note: 根据连续收到的实验反馈修订科学模型的编辑方案，由数值求解器计算参数更新，部分变体使用梯度。

rows.title: WeightLoop: Weight-Space Programming with Experimental Feedback

en.note: An agent specifies an update program. Regularized least squares or L-BFGS fits corrections from experimental feedback, and the validated edits are saved.

zh.note: 由智能体编写更新程序，再用正则化最小二乘或 L-BFGS 根据实验反馈拟合修正量并保存通过验证的编辑。

rows.title: What Does Weight-Space Programming Add to Diffusion Editing? Program Construction versus Score-Guided Refinement

en.note: Separates agent-authored diffusion edit programs from numerical coefficient fitting. Its preregistered rewrite pipeline shows no advantage over a strong comparator.

zh.note: 区分智能体编写扩散模型编辑程序与数值拟合系数两个阶段。预注册的重写流程未优于强基线。

rows.title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits

en.note: Uses discrete weight edits to repair language-model behavior and serves as a non-agent comparator.

zh.note: 通过离散权重编辑修复语言模型行为，为智能体方法提供算法对照。

rows.title: SWEET: Mitigating Spurious Feature Reliance in LLM Reasoning via Weight Editing

en.note: Localizes spurious reasoning features using counterfactual activations and edits weights with a prescribed algorithm.

zh.note: 用反事实激活定位推理依赖的伪相关特征，再按预先定义的算法编辑权重。

rows.title: Reparameterizing Your Object Detectors for Weight Space Programming

en.note: Uses an LLM agent for offline structural diagnosis and operator synthesis. Deterministic reparameterization and numerical calibration then run without LLM calls.

zh.note: 离线阶段用大语言模型智能体诊断结构并构造算子，后续重参数化和数值校准按确定性流程执行，无需调用大语言模型。

rows.title: Can AI Mature a Model's Geometry? Training-Free Weight Baking in LLMs

en.note: An analyst proposes a geometric transformation from weight-derived summaries. Ridge regression writes the parameter update.

zh.note: 分析模型根据从权重导出的摘要提出几何变换，随后用岭回归写入参数更新。

rows.title: Can Weight-Space Programming Alter Learned Ethical Priorities?

en.note: Tests fixed, architecture-guided edits to the fitted readout of a concept-supervised model on a synthetic trade-off task and checks factual and behavioral preservation.

zh.note: 在合成权衡任务上，按预先指定的架构规则编辑概念监督模型已拟合的读出权重，并检查事实准确率与相近行为是否保留。

rows.title: Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT

en.note: Uses causal tracing to motivate rank-one factual updates and introduces CounterFact.

zh.note: 通过因果追踪确定事实编辑的秩一更新，并推出 CounterFact 基准。

rows.title: Mass-Editing Memory in a Transformer

en.note: Extends causal factual editing across layers and larger batches of associations.

zh.note: 将基于因果定位的事实编辑扩展到多个网络层和更大批次的事实关联。

rows.title: AlphaEdit: Null-Space Constrained Knowledge Editing for Language Models

en.note: Projects edits into a null space derived from representations of knowledge to retain.

zh.note: 根据需要保留的知识表示确定零空间，并将编辑更新投影到其中。

rows.title: Rebuilding ROME : Resolving Model Collapse during Sequential Model Editing

en.note: Studies sequential factual editing failures and changes the implementation to improve stability.

zh.note: 研究连续事实编辑过程中的失效，并通过修改实现提高稳定性。

rows.title: Provable Repair of Deep Neural Networks

en.note: Solves for weight corrections that satisfy output specifications for supported networks.

zh.note: 求解满足输出规范的权重修正，并适用于论文所覆盖的网络结构。

rows.title: NNrepair: Constraint-Based Repair of Neural Network Classifiers

en.note: Uses failing and passing inputs to localize suspect parameters and solve for a repair.

zh.note: 用通过和未通过测试的输入定位可疑参数，再通过约束求解生成修复补丁。

rows.title: Architecture-Preserving Provable Repair of Deep Neural Networks

en.note: Solves behavioral specifications over input polytopes while preserving the target architecture. [Code](https://github.com/95616ARG/APRNN)

zh.note: 在保持目标架构的条件下求解权重更新，使模型满足定义在输入多面体上的行为规范。 [代码](https://github.com/95616ARG/APRNN)

rows.title: Pruning neural networks without any data by iteratively conserving synaptic flow

en.note: A data-free pruning-at-initialization comparator whose pruning scores use gradients.

zh.note: 提供无数据的初始化剪枝对照，其剪枝评分使用梯度。

headings.zh: 权重组合与学习式生成

rows.title: Editing Models with Task Arithmetic

en.note: Adds and negates deltas derived from fine-tuned checkpoints. [Code](https://github.com/mlfoundations/task_vectors)

zh.note: 对从微调检查点提取的权重增量执行加法与取负操作。 [代码](https://github.com/mlfoundations/task_vectors)

rows.title: Git Re-Basin: Merging Models modulo Permutation Symmetries

en.note: Aligns permutation-equivalent units before combining checkpoints.

zh.note: 合并检查点之前，先对齐在置换下功能等价的神经单元。

rows.title: TIES-Merging: Resolving Interference When Merging Models

en.note: Resolves sign conflicts and filters small changes in task deltas.

zh.note: 合并任务向量时处理符号冲突，并过滤幅度较小的变化。

rows.title: Language Models are Super Mario: Absorbing Abilities from Homologous Models as a Free Lunch

en.note: Sparsifies and rescales fine-tuning deltas before merging related models.

zh.note: 先稀疏化并重新缩放微调增量，再合并同源模型。

rows.title: HyperNetworks

en.note: Uses a learned network to produce another network's weights.

zh.note: 训练一个网络来生成另一个网络的权重。

rows.title: Drag-and-Drop LLMs: Zero-Shot Prompt-to-Weights

en.note: Uses a trained hypernetwork to generate task-conditioned adaptation weights.

zh.note: 用训练后的超网络根据任务提示生成适配权重。

rows.title: LoRAGen: Structure-Aware Weight Space Learning for LoRA Generation

en.note: Generates language-conditioned LoRA parameters via a learned latent diffusion model.

zh.note: 通过训练得到的潜空间扩散模型，按语言条件生成 LoRA 参数。

rows.title: Program-as-Weights: A Programming Paradigm for Fuzzy Functions

en.note: Trains a compiler on FuzzyBench to translate fuzzy function specifications into adapters for a frozen interpreter.

zh.status: NeurIPS 2026 录用 · 最终稿 v2
zh.note: 在 FuzzyBench 上训练编译器，将模糊函数的规范转换为供冻结解释器使用的适配器。

rows.title: NeuronGen: Neural Network Parameter Generation via Large Language Models

en.note: Uses checkpoint supervision and instruction tuning to train a language model to emit target-network parameters.

zh.note: 利用模型检查点监督与指令微调，训练语言模型输出目标网络参数。

rows.title: Text-to-LoRA: Instant Transformer Adaption

en.note: Trains a hypernetwork to generate LoRA weights from task descriptions.

zh.note: 训练超网络根据任务描述生成 LoRA 权重。

rows.title: Doc-to-LoRA: Learning to Instantly Internalize Contexts

en.note: Learns to map a context to a LoRA adapter for a fixed target model. It is a trained-generation comparator for writing context into weights.

zh.note: 学习为固定的目标模型将上下文映射为 LoRA 适配器，可作为将上下文写入权重的训练式对照。

rows.title: A Modern Self-Referential Weight Matrix That Learns to Modify Itself

en.note: Learns a runtime update rule for fast weights within the target network.

zh.note: 学习目标网络内部快权重的运行时更新规则。

rows.title: Towards Autoregressive Neural Network Parameter Generation

en.note: Trains a tokenizer over pretrained weight tensors and generates weight tokens autoregressively.

zh.note: 基于预训练权重张量训练分词器，并自回归地生成权重词元。

rows.title: Instant Weight-Space Consolidation for Long-Term Memory in LLMs

en.note: Uses a trained recurrent hypernetwork to consolidate conversation activations into a persistent adapter at inference time.

zh.note: 在推理时用训练后的循环超网络将会话激活整合为持久适配器。

rows.title: TracrBench: Generating Interpretability Testbeds with Large Language Models

en.note: Provides compiled test models with known procedural structure for interpretation. [Workshop listing](https://icml2024mi.pages.dev/posters)

zh.status: ICML 机制可解释性研讨会 2024
zh.note: 提供经编译得到且程序结构已知的测试模型，用于评价解释方法。 [研讨会论文列表](https://icml2024mi.pages.dev/posters)

rows.title: MQuAKE: Assessing Knowledge Editing in Language Models via Multi-Hop Questions

en.note: Tests whether an edit propagates to multi-hop questions that depend on the revised fact.

zh.note: 检验事实编辑是否传播到依赖该事实的多跳问题。

rows.title: Evaluating the Ripple Effects of Knowledge Editing in Language Models

en.note: Measures changes to related facts that follow from an edit.

zh.note: 测量知识编辑对关联事实产生的变化。

rows.title: Model Zoos: A Dataset of Diverse Populations of Neural Network Models

en.note: Provides trained checkpoint populations for weight-level analysis.

zh.status: NeurIPS 数据集与基准赛道 2022
zh.note: 提供成组的训练后模型检查点，用于权重层面的分析。

rows.title: Implicit Zoo: A Large-Scale Dataset of Neural Implicit Functions for 2D Images and 3D Scenes

en.note: Provides neural-field parameter collections for 2D and 3D signals.

zh.status: NeurIPS 数据集与基准赛道 2024
zh.note: 提供一组表示二维和三维信号的神经场参数。

rows.title: AdderBoard

en.note: Tracks hand-coded and trained small Transformers in separate divisions on held-out addition problems.

zh.note: 用留出的加法题评测小型 Transformer，按手写权重与训练所得权重分别排名。
